thb.text: Alexio, a Skyguard, is summoned by the Twelve and told to secretly escort Iris to the garrison at Soli, and they ride out until he spots highwaymen in ambush.
He rescues Iris from her horse and kills the two ambushers, whose weapons are Purphoran, then finds a loyal pegasus and they fly together.
Sheltering from a storm in a cave, Alexio and Iris fall in love and spend the night together.
When attackers close in on the cave, Alexio is shot, sends Iris away on the pegasus and stays to face the bandits.
